title: Seagrove Beach "Azure Leisure" 107 Cypress Hill Road
h1: Seagrove Beach "Azure Leisure" 107 Cypress Hill Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Short walk to the beach and Seaside- Private Pool and sitting spa **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $35 per day**- 5 adult bikes- In-home elevator- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: In the heart of Seagrove Beach, Azure Leisure blends comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. Boasting 2,607 square feet of thoughtfully designed space, this stunning home hosts up to 12 guests across 5 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Friends and family will love the breathtaking Gulf views from the upper-floor balconies, relaxed afternoons in the private pool, and peaceful nights unwinding in the sitting spa. Serene 30A days, nearby Seaside attractions, and walkable beach access await!A cheerful blue façade welcomes guests into this 3-story retreat. The sun-soaked entryway leads to a peaceful living area with comfy sofas and an adjoining kitchen with sleek appliances for poolside refreshments and snacks. Unwind in the loft with a king and twin mattress, or opt for the guest bedroom’s queen Murphy bed, complete with its own bathroom. Entertain friends and family outside—take a dip in the pool, recharge in the sitting spa, and fire up the grill to savor quick bites in the enclosed backyard. An outdoor shower and half bath add convenience, while the washer and dryer keep beach gear fresh.Take the in-home elevator to the second floor, featuring a spacious primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, and balcony, as well as 2 other guest bedrooms sharing a Jack-and-Jill-styled bathroom—one boasts a king bed and the other has a twin-over-king bunk bed and twin trundle that’s perfect for families.The third floor is the heart of the home, blending the living, dining, and kitchen areas into an inviting space for gathering. Settle into the comfy L-shaped sectional and armchairs to take in the stunning Emerald Coast views or enjoy a family movie night. Savor early-morning coffee at the 3-stool breakfast bar and gather for lively conversation around the abutting dining table with 5 white slip-covered chairs and a bench. High-end appliances and a charming island in the gourmet kitchen make meal prep a breeze. Kick back in the guest bedroom on this floor, boasting a king bed and private bathroom. The nearby half bath adds convenience. Admire exceptionally colorful sunsets from the charming third-floor balcony!Azure Leisure blends relaxation and adventure! With on-site parking for 4-5 vehicles—plus 5 complimentary bikes—it’s easy to explore the area, including Seaside restaurants andattractions. For beach access, walk or bike Timpoochee Trail Beach and cross 30A! Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Murphy Bed with additional loft sleeping area with a King and Twin mattress together, Private Kitchen and Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Jack and Jill bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Room Twin-over-King with Twin Trundle, Shared Jack and Jill bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Unfortunately the 4th floor crow nest is not accessible to guests*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
